name: Lifeguard and Summer Jobs at Splash Montana and Currents
org: City of Missoula Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard course. Then work at Splash Montana or the Currents Aquatics Center. Other summer jobs there do not need you to be certified.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 and up to lifeguard. Ages 16 and up to be a Water Safety Instructor. You need average swimming ability. Other pool jobs have no lifeguard rule stated.
pay_detail: The city reimburses the Red Cross training course if you accept a lifeguard or Water Safety Instructor job. Hourly pay is not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says summer jobs will be posted soon on the City of Missoula jobs portal.
how_to_apply: Apply for a posted job on the City of Missoula jobs portal. Questions: 406-552-6000 (TTY 406-552-6131).
notes: The page said summer jobs were "posted soon", so check the portal for current openings.
